specification.conditional_rule: any conditional TS/frozen/IFR or gust >=25 promotes prevailing VFR to mvfr risk stratum; no probability-as-certainty
specification.wind_rule: gust crosswind >=15 or gust-scaled tailwind >=10; unknown direction stays unknown unless peak speed <10 bounds both thresholds
specification.limitations: Reporting-carrier throughput proxy, not facility AAR. Conditional mvfr means forecast risk, not literal MVFR. No probability/hazard linkage recoverable from aggregates.

test_disclosure: 2025 already inspected by team; updated held-out backtest, not pristine external validation. Not used in selection.
